## Overview

LRPGF12 is [`lrp-rli-gf-009`](../lrp-rli-gf-009) — the **gain-factors** model for taught receptive vocabulary (`b1retau`), ANCOVA on the period post-count given its pre-count, Beta-Binomial logit with a child random intercept — extended with the standardised transfer-vocabulary skills as **adjusted associations** (#421 Tier 1). `gf-009` deliberately carries no `skill_symbols`, because under the revised DAG the standardised measures RV/EV sit *downstream* of taught vocabulary (`TR → RV`); but the letter-sound → word-reading review found broad **receptive** vocabulary the single clearest predictor of taught-word learning anywhere in the suite. (The review's headline figure came from a probe that also carried `L` alongside `R`/`E`; this registered model fits `R`/`E` only, so that number is motivation, not a prediction for this fit.) This model surfaces that association explicitly by adding `skill_symbols = ("R", "E")` — receptive (RV) and expressive (EV) vocabulary — alongside the randomised term, own baseline, age, cognitive ability (block design), and the revised-DAG confounders hearing (HS = `hs`) and phonological memory (RW = `erbto`), each with a missing-indicator; the age$\times$ability precision interaction is the only interaction. The causal headline is interaction-free in `trt` (#391 finding 3): the treatment$\times$ability and treatment$\times$own-baseline moderation questions for TR are carried by the explicitly associational variant [LRPGF09m](../lrp-rli-gf-209/index.qmd), anchored to the per-outcome primary — this alternate adjustment set declares none.

_Causal labelling (DAG guardrails)._

**Only the randomised on-intervention term is causal.** Its **period-1 average marginal effect** — the genuinely randomised, all-untreated-baseline transition — is an available-case modified ITT estimate; `beta_trt` itself is only the on-intervention log-odds contrast. Every other coefficient is an **adjusted association**, latent-GA-confounded. The added `R`/`E` skill terms are emphatically **not** DAG-parent adjustments — they sit downstream of `TR`, so they are entered only to *describe* the review's finding, and read as "associated with", never "drives". The child random intercept is a partial, shrunken stand-in for between-child heterogeneity and does not control latent general ability. Intervention sessions/dose are never conditioned on (a DAG collider); SES is excluded (not a DAG node).

## Model

Beta-Binomial$(N, \mu\kappa, (1-\mu)\kappa)$ on the period post-count, $N = 24$, with
$\operatorname{logit}\mu = \alpha + \alpha_{\text{period}} + \beta_{\text{trt}}\text{OnIntervention} + \gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(\text{pre}) + \gamma_A A_{\text{std}} + \gamma_{\text{ability}}z(\text{blocks}) + \sum_{s}\gamma_s\,\operatorname{logit}_*(s_{\text{pre}}) + \sum_{c}\gamma_c\,z(c) + \gamma_{\text{int}}\,(\text{age}\times\text{ability}) + u_{\text{child}}$, where the $\operatorname{logit}_*(s_{\text{pre}})$ are the period-start (pre-wave) logits of the skill associates receptive (RV = `R`) and expressive (EV = `E`) vocabulary, and the $z(c)$ are the standardised revised-DAG confounders hearing (HS = `hs`) and phonological memory (RW = `erbto`), each with a missing-indicator. Priors: shared template in `priors.py`.
